title: Expose fare-family warnings in Sample Booking App booking detail
summary: When a booking contains mixed fare families, Sample Booking App should surface warning metadata next to each affected itinerary segment.
acceptanceCriteria: API response contains warning codes grouped by itinerary segment id.
Next.js booking detail page renders warning badges from the API response.
Cypress smoke test covers a booking with two affected segments.
Second-brain documentation is updated only with claims supported by the diff and test evidence.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the booking detail page.
Do not rewrite existing pricing modules.
Do not create new Jira, Zephyr, or MCP integrations.
